items.description: Run the jDeploy release preflight and record the package version, target tag, workflow target, and desktop bundle verification evidence.
items.evidence: Release preflight passed for plain serialslinger@2.0.20 and unused v2.0.20 tag. Full Gradle check, desktop bundle verification, Android compile and release AAB build passed: 473 desktop/shared, 241 iOS simulator, 244 shared Android host, and 1 Android app test; zero failures or skips. Android lint passed. Direct npm prepare/package/install/verify/local/pack-preview all passed; installed jDeploy app launched as 2.0.20 PID 15438. Android AAB is unsigned because upload signing is incomplete. Gitleaks history scan covered 215 commits with no leaks.

items.description: Review Android, desktop, and shared changes for parity; either carry behavior across platforms or record why a platform-specific difference is intentional.
items.evidence: Android and desktop both carry explicit selected day counts through writes and verify readback; both show every schedule date and shared versioned session history. Shared history ownership and device wall-clock decoding cover both platforms; Arducon UTC conversion remains unchanged.
